_comment: Polished gold: pure (24 ct) gold buffed to a bright mirror finish, the metal of jewellery, leaf, plating and ingots. Opaque, param-only: a solid metal with no texture of its own at this scale; the finish is the roughness. Base colour from Physically Based 'Gold' (its red, 1.059, clamped to 1). APPROXIMATE: OpenPBR's metal edge tint (specular_color, the F82 tint) and the complex IOR are not carried by the library (F-LC-6), so the colour toward grazing angles is the base colour's Schlick fade, not gold's measured one. Carries every relevant wear layer at 0 (C1): hairline scratches (overlay 1, damage), dust as a deposit (Phase10), fingerprints, gated by the Edges mask (its B channel is the broad corner band meant for a deposit, its A the open faces meant for handling marks, so dust takes slot 2 and fingerprints slot 3). Built by the Phase11 batch.
name: Gold_Polished_Clean_Base_s01_v01

sources.note: roughness_const is not taken (the entry is an ideal mirror); the polish is the judgement below.

sources.why: roughness 0.08 for a buffed jewellery polish: a sharp but not perfect mirror (a real polished face keeps a faint micro-haze).
